grounds.description: Named sources of policies, skills, prompts and graph fragments: git repos or local paths.

git.description: URL of the git repo the ground is cloned from.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to use; perc validate pins it to a commit in percolator.lock.

path.description: Local directory used as the ground; ~ is expanded.

additionalProperties.description: One ground: a git repo at a ref ({ git, ref }) or a local path ({ path }).

extends.description: Another profile this one starts from: its bindings, nodes, rules and use come first as their own layer, and its tracker and runtime apply unless this profile sets them; match and trust_repo_config are never inherited; one level only.

bindings.description: What runs each core stage (intake, groom, plan, implement, review, deliver); after all layers merge, every stage must be bound.

kind.description: agent, builtin, script or gate; inferred from agent, builtin or command when left out.

agent.description: Which agent runs the step (agent nodes only).

model.description: Model the agent uses (agent nodes only); default the agent's own.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent (agent nodes only, claude only); default the agent's own.

skill.description: One skill the agent loads (agent nodes only).

skills.description: Skills the agent loads (agent nodes only).

prompt.description: Task prompt for an agent node: inline text, or { from: <ground>, file: … }; {{run_id}}, {{worktree}} and the other task variables are filled in; default: carry out the stage contract (bindings) or the node's purpose (hooks).

from.description: Name of the ground the prompt file comes from.

builtin.description: Builtin to run: github.intake or github.open_pr or github.comment or github.open_issues or percolator.report or github.release or github.pr_review or github.private_fork_pr or percolator.route_rules or percolator.route (builtin nodes).

command.description: Argv array, never a shell string: the script for a script node ({run_dir}, {outputs_dir}, {worktree} filled in), or the program for agent: command.

before.description: Hook point: run this node before a stage, or before all; at most one of before/after.

after.description: Hook point: run this node after a stage, or after all; at most one of before/after.

once.description: Skip the hook once it has passed in this run, so a loop does not re-run it; default false.

on_fail.description: Bounded back-edge: on fail, loop back to an earlier stage until max_rounds rounds have failed (the first run counts).

back_to.description: Earlier stage the run loops back to when this node fails.

max_rounds.description: Failed rounds allowed before escalating to you, the first run counts; 1 escalates on the first fail; required.
Round cap for the review loop, read from the last node bound to review; default 3.

timeout_s.description: Escalate to you if the step is not done after this many seconds (agent and script nodes only); default no timeout.

escalation.description: Accepted but not used yet; has no effect.

required.description: Locks the node (in bindings, the whole stage binding): later layers may only restate it unchanged; default false.

require_skills.description: Skills that agent nodes in a stage must load.

stage.description: Stage whose agent nodes must load the skills, or * for every stage; a named stage must be bound to an agent node.

allowed_agents.description: Agents that agent nodes may use; default any agent.

max_rounds_ceiling.description: Highest round cap allowed for the review loop and on_fail back-edges; default no ceiling.

required_nodes.description: Nodes that must be defined: a name, or { name, before | after } to also fix where it attaches.

name.description: Name of the node that must exist.

before.description: The node must be attached before this stage (or all); exactly one of before/after.

after.description: The node must be attached after this stage (or all); exactly one of before/after.

pipelines.description: Named pipelines: each its own stages, bindings, nodes, inputs and exit; top-level bindings and nodes belong to feature.

default.description: This is the profile's default pipeline; at most one per profile; default: feature.

description.description: What the pipeline is for; shown when picking a pipeline.

stages.description: Ordered stage names; the first must be intake and the last is the exit stage; only feature may leave it out.

outputs.description: Output keys each stage must write (stage → keys); a stage left out requires none, unless it is a feature stage.

additionalProperties.description: Output keys the stage must write (<key>.md in its outputs directory).

exit.description: How the pipeline ends: pr, comment, issue, none, release, pr_review, private_fork_pr; runs the matching builtin on the last stage when it is unbound.

ticket.description: Whether a run needs a ticket (an issue): required, optional or none; default required.

inputs.description: Named values a run takes (perc run --input key=value), available to prompts as {{input_<name>}}.

required.description: The run cannot start without this input; default false.

description.description: What the input is; shown as the field hint when starting a run.

router.description: This pipeline is a triage router: its last stage, route, hands the ticket to another pipeline; default false.

routes.description: Router only: label rules tried in order before the choose agent; the first match wins.

label.description: Issue label that picks the pipeline.

to.description: Pipeline the ticket goes to when the issue has the label.

items.description: One rule: an issue with this label goes to this pipeline.

choose.description: Router only: the agent that picks a pipeline when no label rule matched; without it the fallback applies.

model.description: Model the agent uses; default the agent's own.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent (claude only); default the agent's own.

prompt.description: Task prompt for the agent; default: pick one of from and write pick.md (pipeline and whether it is unsure).

from.description: Name of the ground the prompt file comes from.
Pipelines the agent may pick from.

confirm.description: When the pick-pipeline gate asks you to confirm the pick: unsure (only when the agent is unsure) or always; default unsure.

fallback.description: Router only: the pipeline used when nothing else picked one; default the profile's default pipeline, or feature when that is a router.

next.description: Issue exit only: the pipeline each opened issue starts a linked run of; default none (the issues just stay open).

match.description: Which repos use this profile; the first matching profile wins; without it, only --profile picks it.

remote.description: Glob or globs matched against the repo's remote URL.

path.description: Glob or globs matched against the repo's path; ~ is expanded.

tracker.description: Issue tracker used for tickets, gates and pull requests.

approvers.description: GitHub logins whose approve/reject comments count at a gate; default the gh user running perc.

runtime.description: How runs are set up: worktrees, base branch, terminals and the Herdr space.

worktree_root.description: Put worktrees under <root>/<repo>/; relative to the config file, ~ expanded; default <repo>/.worktrees.

base.description: Branch the run starts from and opens its PR against; detected from the repo when left out.

keep_terminals.description: Keep step terminals open after they finish; default false.

space.description: Create a Herdr space per run; default true (false skips it).

trust_repo_config.description: Load the repo's own config file as the last layer; default false (refused).

additionalProperties.description: One profile: the graph, tracker and runtime settings for the repos it matches.

profiles.description: Named profiles; the first whose match fits the repo wins, or pick one with --profile.
